rows.information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur
Resource Centre/Hub Under Health Technology Assessment

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur is located in Rajasthan. This recruitment is for an Extramural Research project under Principal Investigator Dr. Kuldeep Singh, Professor and Head of the Department of Pediatrics.

content_sections.heading: About the Project and the Role
content_sections.text: The HTAIn Resource Centre aims to: Build HTA capacity for individuals, institutions and governments. Provide technical assistance on HTA to state governments and MoHFW. Complete HTA studies assigned by the DHR, MoHFW. Publish systematic reviews, scientific papers, policy briefs and communication materials for stakeholders. Present HTA findings at national and international forums. Evidence synthesis: Conduct targeted and systematic reviews, develop protocols, run search strategies, appraise quality, synthesize data and perform meta-analysis. Costing and economic evaluation: Collect and analyze cost data, develop economic evaluation protocols and decision-analytic models with sensitivity analysis, validation and calibration, and collect and analyze model input data. Research and data: Contribute to other assigned HTA research, conduct basic statistical analysis, collect data and supervise data collection sites. Training and workshop: Develop training agendas and communication materials, ensure successful delivery of training, and contribute to teaching and training. Reporting and dissemination: Prepare project reports, manuscripts and policy briefs, and present at conferences, workshops and meetings. Other duties: Perform other tasks assigned by the PI/Co-PI. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Scientist C Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice describes the salary as a consolidated sum without any other benefits, based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skill set and similar factors.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Scientist C Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates need any one of the following: MBBS/BDS with 6 years' experience, or Post Graduate Diploma in medical subjects after MBBS/BDS with 5 years' experience in the relevant field. Post Graduate (MD/MS/DNB/MPH/MDS) after MBBS/BDS with 4 years' research experience in the relevant field. MPH/Master in any branch of Life Science/Master in Health Economics or a related discipline/MHA/M. Pharm with 4 years of experience in the relevant field. Capability of undertaking systematic reviews and/or developing decision analysis models. Minimum 2 years' experience in conducting HTA or health economics-related research. Candidates must have published, in peer-reviewed journals, at least one systematic review and/or meta-analysis and/or HTA study as first author, or more than two as co-author. PhD in the relevant subject (Community Medicine, Preventive and Social Medicine, Pediatrics, Medicine, Tropical Medicine, Community Health Administration, Health administration, Family Medicine, Epidemiology or Public Health), or PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry or Biotechnology from a recognized institute(s). Knowledge of Computer Applications, IT tools, statistical tools, etc. Knowledge of computer tools like Canva/Bio-render, Rayyan/Covidence, Rob2, Robins, RevMan and EndNote/Zotero, and statistical software like SPSS, STATA, R and TreeAge. Detailed knowledge of PRISMA, CONSORT, STROBE, CHEERS and similar guidelines. 1-2 publications in peer-reviewed journals of systematic review and/or meta-analysis and/or HTA study. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and be full-time. The required experience should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications for the post. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-by-case basis. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened, and the list of shortlisted candidates is published on the website. The competent authority reserves the right to conduct a screening/scrutiny test, depending on the number of applicants. Shortlisted candidates are contacted for in-person interviews.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The initial recruitment is for 6 months and may be extended further based on performance. The position is purely temporary/contractual, based on the project and co-terminus with it. There is no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur, or continuation of services in any other project. Contract service does not confer any right to further assignment or regular appointment in the institute. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No inquiries shall be entertained after the due date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Scientist C Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Application form Curriculum vitae Documents related to educational qualifications and experiences Proof of publication (full-text copy or DOI/PubMed link) All essential qualification and experience certificates must be enclosed with the application form. Otherwise, the application will be considered incomplete.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply without being first author on a publication?
faq.answer: Yes, if you are co-author on more than two systematic reviews, meta-analyses or HTA studies in peer-reviewed journals.

faq.question: Q2. How do I prove my publications?
faq.answer: Include a full-text copy or a DOI/PubMed link with your application.

faq.question: Q3. Is any other allowance paid on top of the HRA?
faq.answer: The table of post details gives Rs. 67,000 plus 20% HRA, and the general terms call the salary a consolidated sum without any other benefits.

faq.question: Q4. Can a candidate above 40 years get an age concession?
faq.answer: It may be possible for experienced and skilled persons, to the extent of service in other research projects. This is decided case by case.

faq.question: Q5. Do I need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes, if you work in Government or a Public Sector Undertaking, or are engaged in any research project, including one under the same Principal Investigator. A valid NOC from the competent authority must be produced at the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What should I carry to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents related to age, qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Will AIIMS Jodhpur pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which experience counts for this post?
faq.answer: Only experience gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications counts. It is considered up to the last date of the advertisement.
